input.$description: The Qeet field. One set of tokens for every bordered text-entry surface — Input, Textarea, InputGroup, NumberField, CurrencyInput, MaskInput, PasswordInput, OTPInput, TagInput, Editable — and the recipe pickers (Select, Combobox, DatePicker triggers) align to. Component tokens are the customisation point for one component. They reference SEMANTIC tokens — by token path when the value is theme-agnostic, or through the semantic CSS variable (--qx-color-*) when it is theme-varying, so one declaration covers both themes. A component token must never reference another component's tokens. Everything lives under the `component.*` namespace: the shadcn bridge already publishes leaves named `input`, `card`, `radius` and so on, and a token path cannot be both a leaf and a group. The writing surface is theme-varying — a clean surface-default sheet on light, a recessed well on dark rather than a lifted grey slab — so `background` and `background-disabled` live in the theme overlays.

border-invalid.$description: Boundary of a field whose value is invalid (aria-invalid). The feedback role rather than border.danger so the boundary, the focus outline and the message text are one red; ≥3:1 on every surface in both themes.

border-warning.$description: Boundary of a field inside a Field that carries a FieldWarning. border.warning is a decorative tint (1.6:1 on light) and cannot identify a control, so the feedback role is used; ≥3:1 in both themes.

border-success.$description: Boundary of a field inside a Field that carries a FieldSuccess. Same reasoning as border-warning: the feedback role, not the decorative border tint.

background-readonly.$description: A read-only field drops the writing surface: the value stays at full contrast and selectable, the boundary turns dashed, and nothing suggests it can be typed into.

foreground.$description: The value text. Set explicitly so a field never inherits a status colour from its container.

placeholder.$description: Placeholder text. The semantic placeholder role (≥4.5:1 on the field surface in both themes), not a lowered-opacity value colour.
